_doc: Wild 亚比 of rooms the generated table misses: the 2011-12 story rooms (风暴星系: 巨人山脉, 蔓藤峡谷, 星云海洋,
钻石岛, 斗魂空间, 虚无空间, 幽暗冥州) that tools/story_files.py added to the config overlay, and skycity4.
Applied last by tools/gen_wildpets.py --extra: an entry replaces the generated one of the same 亚比 in that room.
Sources per entry: the era 亚比图鉴 page CollectionPanelPart2 (Jan 2013), the PetDictionaryData 获得方式 text,
百田's April 2012 guides (aola.100bt.com/fenbu/*.html), the era rare-pet panels and the scenes' code.
Levels: only 星云宝地's 18 and 26 come from a 2012 source; the others are RECONSTRUCTED around them
(first forms 16-20, second forms 24-28, rares 22-26). Forms only the later dictionary names are left out.
